'''Yamin Gilla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Gilla was the lead representative of an organization known as the [[Sentient Beings Opposing Violence]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the SBOV held a peace conference in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], which was attacked by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] were able to defeat Muun and afterward, Gilla thanked them for their efforts.
